biography.plain_text: Dinu Patriciu was a Romanian businessman who built his fortune by acquiring and expanding Rompetrol into an international oil group. He sold the business to Kazakhstan's KazMunayGas in two stages, then invested in European property and Georgian banking. Trained as an architect, he also became a prominent Romanian newspaper proprietor.

long_biography.plain_text:
Dinu Patriciu regarded architecture as preparation for organising teams, a conviction he carried into business. He taught at Bucharest's Ion Mincu Institute while maintaining a design practice, and worked on offices and residential developments in the United Arab Emirates. In Romania, his projects included designing the Ministry of Culture's headquarters and developing premises for the national lottery.

Education also became the focus of his charitable foundation. Its Invent Your Future programme offered scholarships to students who combined strong academic results with limited family means. Support was paid monthly throughout the university year, with the possibility of renewal, helping recipients meet the continuing costs of study.
